elements.id-string-5: In order to extract physical observables from experiments with percent precision, radiative corrections on the experimental observables need to be known to sub-percent precision.

elements.id-string-8: In modern experiments the radiative corrections for QCD and QED interactions are of particular interest.

elements.id-string-995: This process is called resummation and it introduces its own counting.
elements.id-string-996: Accounting for all terms of the form $\alpha^n L^n$ is referred to as leading logarithm (LL), the second ``tower'' $\alpha^n L^{n-1}$ is called next-to-leading logarithm (NLL) and so on.
